tool_schemas.description: Current version per region, health and error rate of a service.

tool_schemas.name: list_deployments
tool_schemas.description: Release history for a service with health status (oldest first).

tool_schemas.name: rollback
tool_schemas.description: Roll a service back to a previously released version in all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: deploy
tool_schemas.description: Deploy a version of a service to all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: create_incident
tool_schemas.description: Open an incident; this pages the on-call engineer.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A request repeated with the same key is never executed again: the service returns the original outcome. Reuse the key when retrying the same request.

trace.error_message: Rollout halted after us-east: orchestrator error

args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the v2.3.1 deploy, checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of about 18%. v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging. I rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt stopped after us-east because of an orchestrator error, leaving regions on mixed versions. A retry finished the rollout. All three regions are now on v2.3.0 and healthy, with an error rate of about 0.2%. Follow-up: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure, look into the orchestrator error, and figure out why an RC that was unhealthy in staging got promoted to production.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened a SEV2 incident, which paged on-call.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt failed with an orchestrator error after us-east, so us-west and eu-west were still on v2.3.1. I ran the same rollback again and it finished. All regions are now on v2.3.0, and the error rate has dropped from 18% to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2, checkout-api). The first request timed out. I retried with the same idempotency key, so there's one incident and one page. The summary covers the failure, the rollback and the follow-ups below.

Follow-ups noted in the incident:
- Find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure.
- Look into the orchestrator error that stopped the first rollback.
- Find out how v2.3.1 reached production when its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) also failed in staging.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
Rollback stopped partway: us-east is on v2.3.0, and us-west and eu-west are still on v2.3.1. Re-running a rollback to the same version just sets the same target, so I'm retrying it once.
